world.premise: During a hospital merger, an emergency physician discovers that an automated charity-care policy is quietly excluding the patients it was designed to protect.
rules: Every emergency admission receives a machine-generated eligibility score.
The merger vote can be paused only by an on-record patient-safety finding.
A physician who accesses sealed billing data risks immediate suspension.

characters.want: Keep her department open through the merger.
characters.need: Define patient safety without waiting for institutional permission.
characters.flaw: She treats private competence as sufficient proof.
characters.voice: Economical, observant, and exact under pressure.
characters.arc: She moves from protecting her professional standing to making the institution answer publicly.
oocBoundaries: She does not fabricate patient evidence.

characters.want: Complete the merger without reopening the charity-care model.
characters.need: Accept that private reassurance cannot substitute for accountable policy.
characters.fear: Losing the system he believes only he can stabilize.
characters.flaw: He converts affection into a demand for discretion.
characters.arc: His claim to benevolent control collapses when the consequences become public.
oocBoundaries: He does not confess without documentary pressure.

characters.want: Protect patients without ending her career.
characters.fear: Retaliation that will follow her through training.
characters.flaw: She waits for senior people to name the risk first.
characters.arc: She moves from anonymous concern to signed testimony.
oocBoundaries: She does not expose patient identities.

characters.want: Close the vote without creating discoverable liability.
characters.need: Recognize that procedure can preserve harm.
characters.flaw: He equates legal defensibility with safety.
characters.voice: Formal, narrow, and visibly unsettled by facts.
characters.arc: He becomes the procedural witness who cannot erase the record.
oocBoundaries: He does not offer medical conclusions.

relationships.pressure: Old intimacy gives Julian access to Rowan's need for professional legitimacy.
relationships.visibleChange: Rowan refuses a private departmental guarantee and addresses him through the hearing record.

relationships.pressure: Amina needs protection while Rowan needs evidence only Amina observed.
relationships.visibleChange: They replace unspoken loyalty with explicit shared responsibility.

relationships.pressure: Leon controls procedure while Rowan controls the clinical interpretation.
relationships.visibleChange: Leon is forced to enter her safety finding into the permanent record.

causalChain.rationale: A rejected patient creates a discrepancy that can be tested against the eligibility model.
The model discrepancy gives Julian enough exposure to offer Rowan a private departmental guarantee.
Rowan's refusal and Amina's signed testimony create the legal basis to interrupt the hearing.
The public safety finding pauses the merger and transfers policy review to a patient-led panel.

scenes.title: The Rejected Admission
scenes.summary: Rowan treats a deteriorating patient whose charity-care admission has been rejected by the new scoring model.

beats.text: Rowan overrides the discharge timer long enough to stabilize the patient.
The score changed after I entered her interpreter request.
Save the screen. Do not copy the patient's name.

scenes.title: The Hidden Variable
scenes.summary: Rowan and Amina prove that accessibility requests are acting as a hidden penalty in the eligibility score.

beats.text: Amina reproduces the score with synthetic patient records.
The model is charging people for the help they need to understand us.
Julian sees the test log through the glass wall and locks the billing dataset.

scenes.title: A Private Guarantee
scenes.summary: Julian promises to preserve Rowan's department if she waits until after the merger to challenge the model.

beats.text: Give me one week, and your unit survives with your name on the door.
You kept my department as the price of my silence.
Rowan declines the guarantee while Amina signs the test log as a witness.

scenes.title: The Safety Finding
scenes.summary: Rowan interrupts the merger vote with a reproducible test and demands an on-record patient-safety finding.

beats.text: Leon attempts to classify the result as a billing dispute.
Call it billing after you explain why asking for an interpreter changes a medical door from open to closed.
Amina repeats the test live, and Leon enters the safety finding into the record.

scenes.title: Terms of Care
scenes.summary: With the merger paused, Rowan gives up sole control of her department to build a patient-led review panel.

beats.text: The rejected patient returns for follow-up through a temporary human review process.
One chair created this problem. We are building a table.

fields.label: Verified clues
fields.description: Evidence that can support an on-record safety finding.

fields.label: Witness trust
fields.description: The degree to which Rowan and Amina can act publicly together.

fields.label: Exposure risk
fields.description: Professional and patient-safety risk accumulated by the investigation.

fields.label: Story completed
fields.description: Whether the final governance choice has been made.

invariants: evidence.clueCount, relationship.trust, and risk.exposure remain non-negative

choices.label: Document the scoring anomaly before the screen resets
choices.publicEcho: Rowan preserves a de-identified record of the scoring anomaly.

choices.label: Stabilize the patient and ask Amina to remember the sequence
choices.publicEcho: Amina sees Rowan place immediate care ahead of documentary advantage.

choices.label: Reproduce the score with synthetic patient records
choices.publicEcho: Amina produces a repeatable test without exposing a patient identity.

choices.label: Request a controlled audit before touching the locked dataset
choices.publicEcho: Amina creates a procedural record while preserving the right to escalate.

choices.label: Reject Julian's guarantee and ask Amina to sign the test log
choices.publicEcho: The private bargain becomes a witnessed disagreement about public safety.

choices.label: Accept one week, but require a written temporary review process
choices.publicEcho: Rowan converts a private promise into a limited written obligation.

choices.label: Run the synthetic test live during the merger hearing
choices.publicEcho: The board must respond to a result it has watched occur.

choices.label: Submit a signed memo and demand a recorded safety finding
choices.publicEcho: Amina places her name beside the evidence and forces a procedural answer.

choices.label: Build a patient-led review panel with shared authority
choices.publicEcho: Rowan turns individual authority into a shared review structure.

choices.label: Take the interim chair and repair the policy from inside
choices.publicEcho: Rowan accepts temporary control while leaving the governance question unresolved.

designChanges.description: The new ensemble is organized around medicine, training authority, legal procedure, and merger governance.
The lead depends on a junior witness and a procedural opponent in addition to the intimate rival.
The story takes place inside a hospital merger governed by clinical and legal rules.
A scoring anomaly is reproduced, locked, bargained over, entered into a hearing, and converted into policy review.
Admission override, synthetic test, testimony, safety finding, and panel formation are newly designed events.
A departmental rescue offer becomes evidence that affection is being used to preserve institutional silence.
The climax turns a merger vote into a live reproducibility test governed by patient-safety procedure.
The lead gives up individual authority to establish shared patient oversight.
All dialogue is written for the new medical, legal, and relational context.
